title: DragN Livestock x TFC Compat
description: An addon to Livestock Overhaul and TerraFirmaCraft, patching in some more extreme compats.
body:
**Livestock Overhaul x TFC Compat**

An addon to _Livestock Overhaul_ and _TerraFirmaCraft_, patching in some more extreme compats than what's available in the base LO. This addon is not required for basic compatibility, since it's included in the base Livestock Overhaul, but does add some new features.

**Included Compatibilities**
- Plow. The LO Plow can now be used on TFC grasses/ dirts to make the correct farmland block when tilling. 
- Horse-Drawn Quern. Some O-Mounts, such as horses, donkeys and mules, can now be used to automate Querns by attaching one to it with a lead.
- Rabbit Pellets. Rabbit Poop now provides ample nutrients to farmland, working as a great fertilizer.

**Planned Compatibilities**
- Domestication/ Familiarization. O-Animal compatibility with TFC's deep domestication mechanics.
- Wagon Wood Types. Wagons would be able to come in all TFC wood types.
- Other TFC Animal Replacers. A replacement for other TFC animals into new O-Animal counterparts, providing more consistency.
